admission.justification: A body without its kind's shape hides the status or the open order, so a reader cannot tell whether a task is planned, in work or landed, nor follow what the master still owes.

applicability: The bodies of the four issue kinds this repository publishes: task, master, sprint and completed-master summary.
conditions: The kind is one of the four the standard names.
exclusions: Milestones and historical leaf issues, which this repository never publishes.

evidence: All 39 bodies carry their kind's sections; the master has 202 requirement rows and the sprint 21 completed-master links.

statement: Each issue kind has its named shape: a task opens with purpose, links, requirement IDs, status and waits, then the named sections; a master carries grouped delivery, the open order and the folded requirement table; a sprint links its masters and end; a completed-master summary says what it set out to do, delivered and when.
